title: Page 151
transc:
G. D. Sheldon  Wash'n Aug 11th 1864 11 AM
Growl Flag Aug Fanny For Lester Polkaing Quadrant Waxy Unity
John directs that you will send to Grapes all the
Whiff you can possibly spare Pekin remaining your self merely
in the quackin yoke Italy Forward by very first chance
Inland says the Continental is under orders for Quadroon Wax end


Thayer Phila  Washn D.C. Aug 11, 1864
for C. A. Wal- born
P M Phila ---- If
there are in your office
any letters for Alex Keith
addressed either to Phila or
any other place will you
please seize them & send
them to this Dept at
once by a special messenger
signed C A Dana Asst
Secy War ---- to Thayer
Stop all mesgs from or
to Alex Keith and any
from Norris & Son about
detention of locomotives also any
from any person to Halifax
in regard to same matter
& send <deletion>them</deletion> <insertion>here</insertion> by telegh
Examine your files for 3
days back for same telegrams
